impactOnPreviousClosure: The previous classification 'not-further-determinable substantive room-rental plus address Omgevingsplan' was too pessimistic about source availability. The current Omgevingsplan itself is now a confirmed primary source and must be included in every Doesburg address/activity assessment. It does not by itself establish a single municipality-wide generic room-rental permission outcome because much of the spatial permissibility remains location/activity dependent and legacy plan components can be part of the integrated Omgevingsplan.

qualityLesson: During final sweeps, search explicitly for 'Omgevingsplan gemeente <municipality>' in Lokale regelgeving even where municipal product pages do not expose the direct regulation link. A missing standalone room-rental policy is not equivalent to a missing legal source.
